* Create a subfolder of the current folder with the passed in name.
   * For IMAP, this will be an async operation and the folder won't exist
   * until it is created on the server.
   *
   * @param folderName name of the folder to create.
   * @param msgWindow msgWindow to display status feedback in.
   *
   * @exception NS_MSG_ERROR_INVALID_FOLDER_NAME
   * @exception NS_MSG_FOLDER_EXISTS
   *
   * @deprecated Use createSubfolderAsync/createSubfolderWithListener instead.
   */
  void createSubfolder(in AUTF8String folderName, in nsIMsgWindow msgWindow);

  /**
   * Create a subfolder of the current folder with the passed in name. Returns
   * a promise that resolves to the created nsIMsgFolder on success, or an
   * error code on failure.
   *
   * Expected failure values:
   * NS_MSG_ERROR_INVALID_FOLDER_NAME
   * NS_MSG_ERROR_OFFLINE
   * NS_ERROR_FAILURE (probably canCreateSubfolders returned false)
   * NS_MSG_FOLDER_EXISTS
   * NS_MSG_ERROR_IMAP_COMMAND_FAILED (IMAP, probably means the folder exists)
   * NS_ERROR_UNEXPECTED (EWS, probably means the folder exists)
   * NS_ERROR_NET_ERROR_RESPONSE (Graph, probably means the folder exists)
   * NS_ERROR_CONNECTION_REFUSED (or other network errors)
   * NS_MSG_ERROR_FOLDER_MISSING (the folder should have been created but
   *   for some reason cannot be found)
   *
   * @param folderName name of the folder to create.
   */
  [implicit_jscontext]
  Promise createSubfolderAsync(in AUTF8String folderName);

  /**
   * Create a subfolder of the current folder with the passed in name.
   * Intended for use by C++ callers while createSubfolderAsync is
   * intended for use by JavaScript callers.
   * See createSubfolderAsync for expected statuses.
   *
   * @param folderName name of the folder to create.
   */
  void createSubfolderWithListener(in AUTF8String folderName,
                                   in nsIUrlListener listener);
